content: Google Be Internet Awesome/Interland: 4 pillar mini-games (Tower of Treasure, Kind Kingdom, Reality River, Mindful Mountain) teaching Be Internet Smart/Alert/Strong/Kind/Brave via play; Internet Awesome Pledge; ISTE-aligned free curriculum; explicit no-login, no personal info, cross-device, free; printable activities, certificates, AI literacy + Digital Wellbeing Packets; now also on Roblox and via Highlights magazine (reached 1M US students). Model = game-based, empowerment framing, no accounts. Confirmed by Google sites + blog.google (100M+ children educated).
